titleZh: 稀缺 ↔ 充裕｜空貨架超市續集
hook: 空貨架對爆倉堆——GRE 量感語氣續集。
script: 稀缺：exiguous／paltry／scant／puny；充裕：glut／surfeit／opulence／rife／scads。語義對打：兩邊語氣相反，考試選「褒貶／強弱」對的那側。登場：exiguous（稀少）、paltry（微不足道）、puny（弱小）、scant（不足）、scrimp（吝嗇）、skimp（吝給）。

members.speakLineEn: Their exiguous travel budget allowed only one shared taxi to the museum.
members.speakLineZh: 他們稀少的旅費預算，只夠合搭一輛計程車去美術館。

members.speakLineEn: The prize money looked paltry next to the hours of rehearsal students invested.
members.speakLineZh: 相較學生投入的排練時數，那筆獎金顯得微不足道。

members.speakLineEn: Compared with last year's festival, this week's turnout looked puny and thin.
members.speakLineZh: 和去年的嘉年華相比，這週的出席人數顯得微不足道又稀稀落落。

members.speakLineEn: With scant daylight left, hikers hurried down before the trail grew dark.
members.speakLineZh: 剩餘日光稀少，健行者趕緊下山，免得步道變暗。

related.antonyms: dark, extinguish, heavy, long, retentive, tall

members.speakLineEn: They had to scrimp on snacks all month to afford the train tickets home.
members.speakLineZh: 為了負擔回家火車票，他們整個月都得節省零食支出。

members.speakLineEn: Do not skimp on sleep before finals if you want a clear head in the morning.
members.speakLineZh: 若想早上頭腦清醒，期末前別吝於睡覺、別偷減睡眠。

members.speakLineEn: She would not stint on kindness when a homesick roommate needed company.
members.speakLineZh: 室友想家需要陪伴時，她絕不吝惜善意。

members.speakLineEn: The debate felt anemic until someone raised a sharp question about fairness.
members.speakLineZh: 辯論一直缺乏活力，直到有人提出關於公平的尖銳問題。

members.speakLineEn: History class studied how drought and war once led to a devastating famine.
members.speakLineZh: 歷史課研讀乾旱與戰爭如何曾導致毀滅性饑荒。

members.speakLineEn: Cheap streaming apps can glut your evenings until free time disappears.
members.speakLineZh: 廉價串流軟體可能讓你晚上過量刷劇，直到空閒時間消失。

members.speakLineEn: After a surfeit of dessert samples, nobody wanted another slice of cake.
members.speakLineZh: 試吃過量甜點後，再也沒人想再來一塊蛋糕。

related.synonyms: excess, overabundance, glut, oversupply, repletion, cloy

members.speakLineEn: The hotel lobby showed quiet opulence with marble floors and soft lighting.
members.speakLineZh: 飯店大廳以大理石地與柔光，展現低調的富裕氣派。

members.speakLineEn: Neighbors shared a bounteous harvest of tomatoes from the community garden.
members.speakLineZh: 鄰居們分享社區菜園裡慷慨豐盛的番茄收成。

related.synonyms: big, bighearted, bountiful, freehanded, handsome, giving

members.speakLineEn: Her exuberance after the win lit up the whole locker room with laughter.
members.speakLineZh: 獲勝後她熱情洋溢，讓整個更衣室充滿笑聲。

members.speakLineEn: Rain turned the campus courtyard into a lush carpet of deep green grass.
members.speakLineZh: 雨水把校園中庭變成一片茂盛濃綠的草地。

members.speakLineEn: Rumors were rife in the hallway before the principal posted the real notice.
members.speakLineZh: 校長張貼正式公告前，走廊裡謠言四處充斥。

related.synonyms: prevailing, prevalent, predominant, dominant, overabundant, plethoric

members.speakLineEn: There were scads of unfinished drafts piled beside her laptop last night.
members.speakLineZh: 昨晚她筆電旁堆著大量未完成的草稿。

related.synonyms: tons, dozens, heaps, lots, piles, scores

members.speakLineEn: Packing for one weekend, she discarded every superfluity from her overflowing bag.
members.speakLineZh: 只打包一個週末，她把書包裡每樣多餘物品都拿掉。

members.speakLineEn: A sybaritic spa weekend felt odd after months of cramped dorm life.
members.speakLineZh: 擠宿舍好幾個月後，一個驕奢逸樂的溫泉週末顯得格格不入。

members.speakLineEn: The winning team was magnanimous, praising the rivals for a hard-fought match.
members.speakLineZh: 冠軍隊寬宏大量，稱讚對手打了一場硬仗。

members.speakLineEn: His morning ebullience made even the sleepy bus ride feel brighter.
members.speakLineZh: 他早上的熱情奔放，連昏沉的公車程都顯得明亮些。

members.speakLineEn: She spent a mint on textbooks that first September at college.
members.speakLineZh: 大學第一個九月，她在教科書上花了一大筆錢。

related.synonyms: batch, deal, flock, hatful, heap, lot

members.speakLineEn: Grandpa would regale us with camping stories until the fire burned low.
members.speakLineZh: 爺爺會用露營故事款待我們，直到營火漸漸變小。

members.speakLineEn: The city had to slash festival spending after tax revenue fell sharply.
members.speakLineZh: 稅收大幅下滑後，市府不得不大量削減節慶支出。

related.synonyms: cut, gash, slice, solidus, virgule, diagonal
related.antonyms: expand, switch on, uncut, unmown, untrimmed

members.speakLineEn: A sudden hailstorm can decimate a fruit orchard in a single afternoon.
members.speakLineZh: 一場突如其來的冰雹，可能在一個下午大量毀壞果園。
